FAQs

Branding, explained clearly

Everything you need to know about our branding process, deliverables, timelines, and what it’s like to work with our team.

Explore all FAQs
Why should I invest in branding?

Your brand is the foundation of everything. Website, marketing, communication — without it, nothing connects.

How long does the branding process take?

Most projects take between 4 and 6 weeks depending on complexity and deliverables.

Do you rebrand existing companies?

Yes. Whether you’re refreshing your image or completely reinventing your brand, we handle both.

What’s included in a brand book?

Your brand book covers your logo system, typography, colours, imagery, and usage rules.

Can you design just a logo?

We focus on full brand systems, not one-off logos. A logo is one piece of the puzzle — your brand deserves a complete identity that works everywhere.

What are the key components of a strong brand identity?

Clear positioning, consistent visual elements, defined messaging, and a cohesive digital presence.
